# LCD fonts: Montserrat Medium with Latin-1 (Portuguese accented letters) and
# LVGL's symbols, generated by tools/gen_fonts.sh. A component of its own: C
# sources in src/ would be built with the C++ flags.
idf_component_register(SRCS "font_ui_12.c" "font_ui_14.c" "font_ui_16.c"
                       PRIV_REQUIRES lvgl__lvgl)
